about.title: About Tarchiv
about.intro: Tarchiv is a visual Israeli blog that presents complex topics in a simple, clear, and beautiful way. We believe that important information should be accessible to everyone, and that the best way to understand data is to see it.
about.what_body: In each post, we choose a fascinating Israeli topic and present it through infographics, interactive charts, maps, and up-to-date data. Topics range from infrastructure, society, history, environment, economy, and culture.
about.why_body: The human brain processes images 60,000 times faster than text. Data visualization allows us to see patterns, trends, and connections that are hard to identify when reading tables of numbers. This is our way of expanding understanding.
about.who_body: Tarchiv was born from a love of data and design. We are a small team of information enthusiasts who want to turn dry topics into something fun to read and explore. Every post goes through thorough research, data verification, and careful design.
